subject: Renewal + expansion: volume step-ups, blended rates, new model routes
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Jones <sam.jones@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + next steps (renewal + expansion)

Hi Sam — great to chat today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call summary:
- Renewal: Stellar Retail is approaching renewal for existing routes (Customer Support bot + Search rerank).
- Expansion: You're planning to add two new routes over the next 6–9 months: (1) Summarization for knowledge base articles (lower token/resp), (2) Long-form drafting for marketing (higher token/resp).
- Performance: current latency/SLOs look good with Dedicated pool; you want to maintain sub-500ms p50 for the support route.

Cost/volume qualification (action item for you):
- Current monthly token baseline (all routes): ~65M tokens/month.
- Expected step-ups: +100M tokens/month in Q4 (marketing drafts), and incremental +40M tokens/month for summarization once rolled out.
- Target unit economics: you mentioned an internal target of ~$1,200–$1,800 per 1M tokens (blend goal) — I flagged that as the band we'd aim to hit with volume tiers and blended rates.

Our ask from Stellar Retail this week:
1) Confirm expected monthly token volumes per route (baseline vs target step-up timing).
2) Confirm procurement timeline and any budget range for the renewal/expansion (do you have an internal target ARR or monthly budget we should align with?).
3) Any DPA/KM requirements we should include in the renewal paperwork?

What we’ll do next:
- I’ll draft a renewal + expansion pricing proposal with volume step-ups, blended rates, and modeling for new routes — will include unit economics ($/1M tokens) and example monthly cost scenarios.
- Share an initial PDF + spreadsheet for your finance/procurement review.

If you can reply with the per-route volumes this week, I can get a first pass over to you by Thursday.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

Attachment stubs: REDWOOD_pricing_proposal_v3.pdf (proposal), volume_projection_q3-q4.xlsx (projection)

From: Sam Jones <sam.jones@stellarretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (renewal + expansion)

Thanks Marissa — good call. A couple clarifications and the numbers you asked for below.

Per-route expected volumes (estimates):
- Customer Support (current): 45M tokens/month baseline. Expect +10% seasonality in Q4 -> ~49.5M.
- Search rerank (current): 20M tokens/month. Stable.
- Summarization (new, pilot in Oct): estimate 15M tokens/month once live (mainly short outputs).
- Marketing long-form (new, ramp Nov–Dec): estimate 100M tokens/month by Jan (high variance).

Budget constraints:
- Procurement provided a budget range for expanded spend of $120k–$180k/month for ML/LLM consumption (this is for all LLM-related costs, not just inference).
- Our finance team expects blended unit target closer to $1,500 per 1M tokens but can stretch to $1,800 for the first two quarters of expansion if we get strong cost predictability and tooling (batching/caching) to lower unit costs later.

Other notes:
- Procurement (cc’d) would like to see firm stepped pricing with blended examples.
- We will need an updated SLA addendum and SOC2 evidence for procurement sign-off.

Thanks — I’ll review your proposal when you send it.

Sam
Director of AI Products | Stellar Retail
sam.jones@stellarretail.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Jones <sam.jones@stellarretail.com>, Priya Singh <procurement@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: REDWOOD pricing proposal (renewal + expansion) — step-ups & blended rates

Hi Sam/Priya — attaching the proposal and a projection workbook for finance. Key items called out here in case you want the short version: 

Executive summary:
- We modeled three volume tiers (monthly tokens across all routes): Tier A 0–100M, Tier B 100–300M, Tier C 300M+.
- Blended unit pricing (examples): Tier A = $2,200 / 1M tokens; Tier B = $1,600 / 1M tokens; Tier C = $1,100 / 1M tokens.
- With your projected ramp (baseline 65M + marketing + summarization), you land in Tier B by Jan; blended example comes to ~$1,580 / 1M tokens (detailed in sheet).

Volume step-ups & onboarding credits:
- Q4 pilot: we propose a temporary pilot credit for the summarization route (first 2 months) to accelerate testing.
- Step-up discount schedule: 0–100M (base rates), 100–200M (-20% unit), 200–400M (-35% unit) applied as blended step-downs.

Adding new model routes & route differentiation:
- We price by request type (low-latency chat vs long-form generation) and by model family. Adding the summarization route (smaller responses, cheaper per-response compute) is modeled at ~60% of the long-form unit cost in the workbook.
- If you want to pin a higher-quality model for marketing (larger context, slower kernels), that route has a +25% unit uplift in the proposal.

Unit economics and target $/1M tokens:
- Based on your budget range ($120k–$180k/mo for LLM), the blended units above map to monthly token capacity as follows in the sheet: $120k/mo -> ~75M tokens at $1.6k/1M; $180k/mo -> ~112.5M tokens at $1.6k/1M.
- If you hit Tier C volumes (300M+), we can get below $1.2k/1M in blended terms.

Attachments included: REDWOOD_pricing_proposal_v3.pdf (summary + legal), volume_projection_q3-q4.xlsx (per-route scenarios).

Next steps:
1) Priya — can procurement confirm whether the pilot credit is acceptable and the expected PO timing?
2) Sam — let me know if we should price the marketing route with the +25% quality uplift or keep it at base long-form pricing for now.
3) We can set up a short call (30 mins) next week to walk finance through the workbook.

Thanks — attaching now.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: REDWOOD pricing proposal (renewal + expansion) — step-ups & blended rates

Marissa — quick internal note before we sync with legal/finance: 

- The proposed Tier B blended (~$1,600 / 1M) gets us to the margin band we want if we assume 30% of traffic benefits from batching & KV caching (we used conservative caching assumptions). If Stellar hits the higher end of their $180k/mo budget we can escalate to Tier C quickly and still preserve 18–22% gross margin after infra costs.
- I think the pilot credit for summarization is reasonable (2 months) but ask if we should make it conditional on a minimum pilot spend ($10k) to avoid open-ended tests.
- Also confirm the +25% uplift for pinned marketing model — that's material. If they want a heavily tuned/locked model, we should price separately as an add-on rather than bake into blended tiers.

If you’re aligned, I’ll approve the numbers and loop in Legal for the SLA addendum redline.

Thanks —
Aditya
Head of Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
